alvenorm-forte.text: Adults: 1 teaspoon (5 ml), neat or in a little water, 1–2 times a day, before meals or 1 hour after.

bonomarlot.text: Bonomarlot® instructions: 1-2 capsules or tablets 1-2 times a day with meals. The duration of administration is 30 days. It is advisable to repeat the course in 3-6 months.

bonothyrk.text: Bonothyrk® instructions: 1-2 capsules or tablets with meals 1-2 times a day. The duration of administration is 30 days. It is advisable to repeat the course in 3-6 months.

cartalax.text: Adults are advised to take 1-2 capsules 1-2 times daily with meals. The duration of admission is 10-30 days. It is advisable to repeat the course in 4-6 months.

cerluten.text: CERLUTEN® is recommended to be taken 10-15 minutes before meals, 1-3 tablets or capsules 2-3 times a day for 10-20 days. A second course is advised in 3 - 6 months.

chelohart.text: Take 1-2 capsules or tablets of CHELOHART® 1-2 times a day with meals. Duration of admission is 30 days. It is advisable to repeat the course in 4-6 months.

chitomur.text: Take 1-2 capsules or tablets of CHITOMUR® 1-2 times a day with meals. Duration of admission is 30 days. It is advisable to repeat the course in 4-6 months.

chonluten.text: Adults are advised to take 1-2 capsules 1-2 times daily with meals. The duration of admission is 10-30 days. It is advisable to repeat the course in 4-6 months.

complex-3r.text: Adults: 1 tablet once or twice a day with meals. Course duration: 4–6 weeks; the course can be repeated within a year if needed.

crystagen.text: Adults are advised to take 1-2 capsules 1-2 times daily with meals. The duration of admission is 10-30 days. It is advisable to repeat the course in 4-6 months.

endoluten.text: Adults: 1 capsule every 3 days, in the morning or at midday. Course: 20 days to 2 months.

ensil.text: Adults: 1 capsule 3 times a day with meals. Course duration: 1 month; the course can be repeated.

glandokort.text: Glandokort® instructions: 1-2 capsules or tablets with meals 1-2 times a day. The duration of admission is 30 days. It is advisable to repeat the course in 4-6 months.

gotratix.text: GOTRATIX® is recommended: 1-2 capsules or tablets 2-3 times a day with meals. The duration of admission is 30 days. It is advisable to repeat the course in 4-6 months.

libidon.text: It is recommended to take LIBIDON® 1-2 capsules or tablets 1-2 times a day with meals. The duration of admission is 30 days. It is advisable to repeat the course in 4-6 months.

ovagen.text: OVAGEN® is recommended to be taken 10-15 minutes before meals, 1-2 tablets or capsules 2-3 times a day for 15-20 days. A second course could be repeated in 3 - 6 months.

pielotax.text: Take 1-2 capsules or tablets of PIELOTAX® 1-2 times a day with meals. The duration of admission is 30 days. It is advisable to repeat the course in 4-6 months.

pinalex-tab.text: Adults: 1 tablet 2–3 times a day with meals. Course duration: 1 month. Repeated courses are allowed.

pinealon.text: PINEALON® is recommended to be taken 10-15 minutes before meals, 1-3 tablets or capsules 2-3 times a day for 10-20 days. It is desirable to repeat the course in 3 - 6 months.

revifort.text: Adults: 1 capsule 2 times a day with meals for 15 days, then a break of at least 10 days, then another 15 days.

revilab-anti-age.text: Take 1 capsule per day during meals. Course duration: 4-6 weeks. Can be repeated as necessary throughout the year.

zinsil-t.text: Take 1 tablet 2 times daily, chewing during meals. Duration: 1 month. May be repeated as needed.
